senses.gloss: मन्द- + अक्ष मन्द- + अक्ष, n. modesty.
मान- + अर्ह मान- + अर्ह, adj. entitled to [] respect, Man. 2, 137.
मन्द- + आत्मन् मन्द- + आत्मन्, adj. dull, foolish.
मानस- + आलय मानस- + आलय, m. a wild swan, or goose.
मन्द- + आस्य मन्द- + आस्य, n. modesty.
मानस- + ओकस् मानस- + ओकस्, m. the wild swan or goose.
मांस-भूतोदन मांस-भूतोदन (instead of ˚तौ˚), i. e. -भूत-, a dish of rice and meat(?), Rām. 2, 52, 83.
मन्द- + औत्सुक्य मन्द- + औत्सुक्य, adj. having no great desire, Śāk. 18, 22.
मनस्- + गत मनस्- + गत, desired, Chr. 20, 18.

मनोगत मनोगत, i. e. मनस्-गत (vb. गम्),
 I. adj. Seated in the mind.
 II. n.
 1. Thought.
 2. Wish, Chr. 20, 18.
मन्त्र- + गुह्य मन्त्र- + गुह्य, m. a spy.
मान- + ग्रन्थि मान- + ग्रन्थि, m. 1. pride, 2. fault, वस्त्र-, m. the string by which the lower garments are fastened above the hips.
मन्द- + चेतस् मन्द- + चेतस्, adj. fainting, Chr. 29, 35.

मनोजव मनोजव, i. e. मनस्-,
 I. adj. 1. swift as thought. 2. quick in thought, 3. fatherly, parental.
 II. m. Viṣṇu.
मनोज्ञ मनोज्ञ, i. e. मनस्-, adj. beautiful, Lass. 53, 2.

मनोज्ञ मनोज्ञ, i. e. मनस्-ज्ञ,
 I. adj. Beautiful, Ṛt. 6, 25.
 II. f.
 1. A princess.
 2. Red arsenic.
मनस्- + ताल मनस्- + ताल, m. the lion of Durgā.
मांस- + तेजस् मांस- + तेजस्, n. marrow or serum of the flesh.
मनस्- + दण्ड मनस्- + दण्ड, m. control over the mind.
मनुष्य- + धर्मन् मनुष्य- + धर्मन्, m. Kuvera, the god of wealth.
मन्त्र- + धारिन् मन्त्र- + धारिन्, adj. sbst. a counsellor, MBh. 5, 926.
मनःशिला-चन्दन- + धावन मनःशिला-चन्दन- + धावन, n. a preparation made of red arsenic and sandal, Rām. 6, 96, 3 Gorr.
मान- + पर मान- + पर, adj., f. रा, arrogant, proud, Śiś. 9, 57.
मांस- + परिविक्रयिन् मांस- + परिविक्रयिन्, m. a fleshmonger.
मन्द- + फल मन्द- + फल, adj., f. ला, bearing scanty fruit, Lass. 35, 20.
मन्द- + बुद्धि मन्द- + बुद्धि, adj. stupid.
मन्द- + भागिन् मन्द- + भागिन्, adj. unhappy, Utt. Rāmac. 79, 11.
मन्द- + भाग्य मन्द- + भाग्य, adj. unhappy, Vikr. 32, 8.

मंह् मंह्, i. 1, Ātm.
 1. To increase.
 2. To give (ved.).
 --i. 10 and 1, Par. † To speak, to shine. Frequent. ved. मामक्, To grant, Chr. 298, 25 = Rigv. i. 112, 25.
मंहना मंहना, f. Liberality, Lass. 98, 2 (read मंहना) = Rigv. vi. 64, 5.
मन्द- + मति मन्द- + मति, adj. foolish, Pañc. 229, 12.

मन् मन्, i. 4, and ii. 8, Ātm. (in epic poetry, and also elsewhere Par., e. g. Pañc. ii. d. 97).
 1. To think, Chr. 10, 3; 154, 16; Pañc. i. d. 126 (समं विषमम् एव च मन्यते, To consider even and odd, i. e. to make long reflections); with अन्यथा, To doubt, Utt. Rāmac. 104, 2.
 2. To wish, Vikr. 12, 9.
 3. To mind, MBh. 3, 2092; with न, To disregard, Johns. Sel. 53, 125.
 4. To believe, Rājat. 5, 255; Chr. 14, 27.
 5. To understand, Vedāntas. in Chr. 215, 15.
 6. To know, Lass. 98, 7 = Rigv. v. 9, 1; Daśak. in Chr. 183, 23.
 7. To mention, to declare, Chr. 296, 2 = Rigv. i. 112, 2 (मन्तवे, ved. infin. ‘So many that even a loquacious man cannot reckon them up’).
 8. To take, to value, Pañc. ii. d. 97; i. d. 190; with बहु, To estimate highly, Rājat. 5, 276.
 9. मन्ये is often inserted without syntactic connection.
 a. To strengthen an assertion, Lass. 72, 13.
 b. In order to give it a modest form, Daśak. in Chr. 182, 15.
 c. Ironically, Rām. 3, 51, 25.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. मत.
 1. Admitted, Bhāṣāp. 57.
 2. Believed, held, Man. 1, 76.
 3. Understood, known.
 4. Desired, with gen., Chr. 15, 2; Kir. 5, 27.
 5. Respected, regarded. n.
 1. Purpose.
 2. Opinion, Indr. 3, 1.
 3. Doctrine, Pañc. 253, 12.
 4. Knowledge.
 5. Wish.
 --Comp.
 --Comp. ptcple. of the fut. pass. अ-मीमांस्य, adj. Not to be questioned, Man. 2, 10.
 --Caus., and i. 10, मानय,
 1. To estimate highly, to honour, MBh. 8, 2424; also Ātm., Chr. 43, 23.
 2. To love, Rām. 1, 38, 8.
 3. Ātm. †
 1. To be proud.
 2. † To be stupid. Anomal. ptcple. of the pres. Ātm. in the signification of the Par. मानयान, MBh. 3, 13111. मानित, Honoured, Chr. 28, 23. मान्य, माननीय, To be honoured, Bhartṛ. 2, 70; Rājat. 5, 337.
 --With the prep. अनु अनु,
 1. To assent, Man. 9, 97.
 2. To approve, Rām. 2, 2, 13.
 3. With न, To disown, Ragh. 16, 85.
 4. To permit, Rām. 2, 21, 45.
 5. To pardon, Śāk. d. 116. अनुमत,
 1. Assented to, Man. 3, 4.
 2. Concurred with.
 3. Accepted, Daśak. in Chr. 184, 3.
 4. Agreeable.
 5. Beloved. n. Assent, Man. 5, 151; Vikr. d. 58.
 --Caus.
 1. To cause to approve, Rām. 2, 2, 8.
 2. To honour, MBh. 3, 278.
 3. To cause to agree, to bring in analogy with, Daśak. in Chr. 188, 1.
 --With अभि अभि,
 1. To intend, Pañc. 15, 23.
 2. To desire, Man. 10, 95.
 3. To approve, MBh. 2, 1374.
 4. To believe, Bhaṭṭ. 5, 71.
 5. To consider, Pañc. iii. d. 154.
 6. To surpass, MBh. 3, 1388. अभिमत,
 1. Wished.
 2. Assented to.
 3. Agreeable, Megh. 50.
 4. Beloved, Pañc. i. d. 80. n. Wish, Hit. 57, 5, M.M.
 --Comp.
 अन्-अभिमत-, adj. disagreeable, Hit. 15, 2, M.M.
 यथा-अभिमत + म्, adv. according to one's wish; how one lists, ad libitum, Pañc. 167, 24.
 --With अव अव, To despise, Man. 4, 135; Vikr. d. 30.
 2. To offend, Man. 8, 84.
 --Caus. To despise, Man. 2, 50.
 --With अभ्यव अभि-अव, To disdain, Man. 4, 249. []
 --With प्रति प्रति, Caus. To honour, Rām. 3, 53, 27.
 --With वि वि, विमत,
 1. Disliking.
 2. Disagreeing. m. An enemy (rather मत with वि).
 --Caus. To disgrace, Śāk. d. 116. विमानित, Dishonoured, Pañc. i. d. 127.
 --With सम् सम्,
 1. To think, Rām. 3, 52, 2.
 2. To resolve, Rām. 3, 53, 4. संमत;
 1. Assented to, approved; अश्वपृष्ठे संमत, A good horseman, Rām. 1, 19, 19.
 2. Conformable.
 3. Like, resembling, Chr. 32, 23.
 4. Attached to.
 5. Beloved, Man. 3, 39; Pañc. i. d. 65. n. Opinion, Hit. 48, 1.
 --Comp.
 सु-, adj. much approved, honoured, Chr. 49, 14.
 --Caus. To honour, Rām. 2, 16, 15; Chr. 22, 26.
 --Cf. म्ना, मति; μένος, μέμονα, αὐτό-ματος (= मत), μάτην, μάταιος (not real, only imagined), μάντις, μαίνομαι, μῆνις, μαίομαι, μέμαα; Lat. monere, monstrum, monstrare, mentiri (cf. मति), mendax; Goth. munan, muns, munths (cf. मन्त्र); A.S. manian, monian, ge-munan, mudh.
मान् मान्, i. 10 (properly Caus. of मन्, q. cf.), and † i. 1, Par. To honour.

मनन मन् + अन, n. + मत
 1. Minding, considering, Vedāntas. in Chr. 216, 1; cf. 21.
 2. Understanding.

मनस् मन् + अस्, n.
 1. Mind, Chr. 3, 8; Man. 1, 104; considered as seat of perception (MBh. 14, 668), and passion, the heart, Vikr. d. 19; Bhāg. P. 5, 11, 9.
 2. The intellect, Vedāntas. in Chr. 206, 24; power of mind, Chr. 27, 7.
 3. Purpose, Chr. 12, 23; Rājat. 5, 251.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. μένος, δυσμένης (= दुस्-), εὐμενής (= सु-), and म्ना.

मनस मनस् + अ, A substitute of मनस् as latter part of compounds; e. g. प्रमत्त-, adj. Furious, Chr. 35, 6. प्रवास-उत्सुक-, adj., f. सा, One whose mind is directed to his foreign residence, to the place to which he is about to depart, Vikr. 61, 17. राङ्मनस, i. e. राच्-,
 I. n. sing. or du. Word and mind, Vedāntas. in Chr. 202, 3.
 II. f. सा, The goddess of the serpent race.

मानस मानस, i. e. मनस् + अ,
 I. adj., f. सी, Mental, Man. 2, 85; Vikr. d. 30.
 II. n.
 1. The mind, the seat of reasoning and feeling, Pañc. v. 12; Bhāṣāp. 33; Hit. i. d. 140, M.M.; Pañc. iii. d. 45 (भय-संत्रस्त-, adj. Having one's mind terrified by fear); iii. d. 180 (शोक-संतप्त-, burned by grief).
 2. The name of a lake, Vikr. d. 93.
 III. f. सी, A goddess of [] the Jainas.
 --Comp.

मनसिज मनस् + इ-ज,
 I. adj. Mental.
 II. m. The god of love, Vikr. d. 12.
मनसिशय मनसिशय, i. e. मनस् + इ शि + अ, m. Love, Vikr. d. 49.

मनस्विता मनस्विता, i. e. मनस्विन् + ता, f.
 1. Intelligence.
 2. Hope.

मनस्विन् मनस् + विन्,
 I. adj.
 1. Intelligent, Pañc. ii. d. 128; prudent, [] Vikr. d. 46.
 2. Attentive.
 II. f. नी, A virtuous woman, Rām. 3, 55, 34.

मनाक् मनाक्, probably *मन- (for मा + न, ptcple. pf. pass. of मा; cf. μανός and μινυν in μίνυνθα, μινυ in μινύθω; Lat. minu in minuo; Goth. mins, minz, minniza, minnists, which are also derived from मा) -अञ्च्, adv. A little, Hit. ii. d. 138.
 --Comp.
मनाका मनाका, f. A female elephant.
मनायु मनायु, i. e. *मनाय, a denomin. derived from मनस् with य, + उ, adj. Intelligent, Chr. 294, 9 = Rigv. i. 92, 9.

मनीषा मन् + ईषा, f.
 1. Intellect.
 2. Hymn, Chr. 298, 24 = Rigv. i. 112, 24.
 --Comp.

मनीषित मनीषित, i. e. मनीषा + इत, adj.
 1. Cherished in mind, Chr. 18, 35.
 2. Aimed at, desired, 12, 4.

मनीषिन् मनीषिन्, i. e. मनीषा + इन्, adj., f. इणी, Intelligent, wise, Man. 2, 14.
 --Comp.

मनु मनु, curtailed मनुस्, q. cf.
 I. m.
 1. A man.
 2. Manu, the progenitor of mankind, Man. 1, 1; 36 (Chr. 297, 16 = Rigv. i. 112, 16).
 II. f. मनावी and मनागि, The wife of Manu.

मनुज मनु-ज,
 I. m. A man in general, Bhartṛ. 2, 98.
 II. f. जा, A woman.
 --Comp.

मनुष्य मनुष्य, i. e. मनुस् + य,
 I. m. Man, a man, Pañc. 255, 17; mankind, Man. 1, 39.
 II. f. षी, A woman.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. O.H.G. mannisco; Goth. mannisks; A.S. mennesc, mennisc.

मानुष्य मानुष्य, i. e. मानुष + य,
 I. adj. Human, Nal. 19, 28.
 II. n. The state of a man.
मनुष्यत्व मनुष्य + त्व, n. Condition of man, manhood, Man. 12, 40.

मनुस् मनुस्, for original मन्वन्त् (ptcple. pres. Par. of मन्, ii. 8), m. Man (ved.).
 --Cf. मनु; German mannus (Tacit. Germ. 2); Goth. man, manna; A.S. man, mann; Lat. mas, maris; Μίνως.
मनोजू मनोजू, i. e. मनस्-जू, adj. Swift as thought, Chr. 291, 4 = Rigv. i. 85, 4.
मनोभव मनोभव, and मनोभू मनोभू, i. e. मनस्-भू + अ, and मनस्-भू, m. The god of love, Pañc. 128, 5 (भव); Kathās. 3, 62 (भू).
मनोरम मनोरम, i. e. मनस्-रम् + अ, adj. Beautiful, Pañc. 127, 24.
मनस्- + रम मनस्- + रम, see s. v. मनोरम.

मनोहर मनोहर, i. e. मनस्-हृ + अ, adj. Beautiful, charming, Vikr. d. 9; 119.
 --Comp.
मनोह्वा मनोह्वा, i. e. मनस्-ह्वे + अ, f. Red arsenic.

मन्तु मन् + तु,
 I. m.
 1. A man.
 2. A king.
 3. Offence.
 II. f. Intellect.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. μαντεύομαι.
मन्तूय मन्तूय, a denomin. derived from मन्तु with य, Par. To be offended or jealous, Bhaṭṭ. 5, 73.

मन्तृ मन् + तृ, m.
 1. A wise man.
 2. An adviser.
 --Cf. Μέντωρ.

मन्त्र् मन्त्र्, i. 10 (properly a denomin. derived from मन्त्र), Ātm. (but often also Par.).
 --† i. 1, Par.
 1. To take secret council with (with instr. and acc.), Man. 7, 146; Pañc. rec. orn.
 2. To deliberate, Rām. 2, 16, 15.
 3. To resolve, Hit. 129, 13.
 4. To speak, Hit. 64, 6 (Par.).
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. मन्त्रित, Advised.
 --Comp.
 See कु-.
 --With the prep. अनु अनु,
 1. To accompany with spells or prayers, to consecrate by spells, to charm, Chr. 31, 12; Utt. Rāmac. 39, 10.
 2. To dismiss, MBh. 3, 39.
 --With अभि अभि, To consecrate by blessings, Rām. 1, 24, 2; by spells, to charm, Draup. 8, 54.
 --With आ आ,
 1. To address, Rām. 1, 1, 8.
 2. To salute, MBh. 3, 2243.
 3. To invite, Man. 3, 191; Pañc. 26, 20.
 4. To call, Utt. Rāmac. 125, 9.
 5. To ask, MBh. 4, 64.
 6. To take leave (acc.), MBh. 3, 2295.
 --With समा सम्-आ, To address, MBh. 2, 42.
 --With उप उप,
 1. To address, Daśak. in Chr. 197, 10.
 2. To invite, Rām. 1, 46, 12.
 3. To take leave (acc.), Chr. 45, 11.
 --With नि नि, To invite, Man. 3, 187; to present with (with instr.) Pañc. iii. d. 139.
 --With उपनि उप-नि, []
 1. To invite, Rām. 3, 52, 51.
 2. To consecrate, MBh. 3, 15959.
 --With संनि सम्-नि, To invite, MBh. 3, 2112.
 --With परि परि, To consecrate, to charm, Arj. 7, 18.
 --With सम् सम्,
 1. To take council with (instr.), Pañc. 25, 13; Chr. 53, 6.
 2. To deliberate, Man. 7, 216.
 3. To reflect, Pañc. 25, 14.
 4. To salute, MBh. 1, 5454.
 --Cf. probably Goth. mathljan; see मन्त्र.

मन्त्र मन् + त्र, m.
 1. That part of the Veda which comprises the hymns, Madhusūdana in Weber, Ind. St. i. 14.
 2. A holy text, Vikr. 87, 10; Pañc. 189, 24.
 3. A mystical verse or incantation, charm, Pañc. i. d. 73.
 4. Prayer, Vikr. 32, 16.
 5. A formula sacred to any individual deity.
 6. Advice, Hit. 54, 14; secret consultation, Pañc. i. d. 61 (मन्त्रं सम्-आ-चर्, To intrigue).
 7. A design, Hit. i. d. 128, M.M.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. probably Goth. mathl, mathleins.

मन्त्रज्ञ मन्त्र-ज्ञ, m.
 1. A spy.
 2. A priest.
 --Comp.
मन्त्रण मन्त्रण, i. e. मन्त्र् + अन, n., and f. णा, Advising.

मन्त्रतस् मन्त्र + तस्, adv.
 1. = abl. of मन्त्र, Man. 3, 65.
 2. Advisedly, deliberately.

मन्त्रवन्त् मन्त्र + वन्त्,
 I. adj., f. वती.
 1. Accompanied with holy texts, [] Man. 2, 29.
 2. Entitled to use the Vedas.
 3. Initiated.
 II. ˚वत्, adv. With holy verses, hallowed by holy texts, Man. 2, 64.

मन्त्रविद् मन्त्र-विद्,
 I. adj.
 1. Conversant with the Vedas, Johns. Sel. 42, 51.
 2. Conversant with charms, Daśak. in Chr. 187, 9.
 II. m.
 1. A spy.
 2. A counsellor, Chr. 55, 6.
 3. A priest.
 --Comp.
मन्त्रिक मन्त्रिक, i. e. मन्त्र + इक, m. One who is conversant with charms, Lass. 17, 8.
मान्त्रिक मान्त्रिक, i. e. मन्त्र + इक, m. A sorcerer, Rājat. 5, 102.

मन्त्रिता मन्त्रिता, f., and मन्त्रित्व मन्तृत्व, n., i. e. मन्त्रिन् + ता or त्व, The state or office of a counsellor, ministership, Hit. 54, 14.
 --Comp.

मन्त्रिन् मन्त्रिन्, i. e. मन्त्र + इन्, m. A counsellor, Pañc. i. d. 428 (अ-सन्त्-, adj. Having wicked counsellors).
 --Comp.
मन्त्रिवत् मन्त्रिवत्, i. e. मन्त्रिन् + वत्, adv. Like a counsellor, Rājat. 5, 389.
मन्थ् मन्थ्, see मथ्.
† मान्थ् मान्थ् (?), i. 1, Par. To hurt (see मथ्).

मन्थ मन्थ, curtailed मन्थन् (see मथिन्), m.
 1. A churning-stick.
 2. The sun.
 3. Churning, Utt. Rāmac. 172, 12.
 4. Stirring, Ragh. 3, 10.
 5. Killing.
 --Comp.
मन्थज मन्थ-ज, n. Butter.

मन्थन मन्थ् + अन,
 I. n.
 1. Churning, MBh. 1, 1141. Agitating.
 II. f. नी, A churn.
 --Comp.
मन्थान मन्थान (vb. मन्थ्), m. A churning-stick, Rām. 1, 45, 19.

मन्थर मन्थ् + अर,
 I. adj.
 1. Slow, Daśak. in Chr. 182, 2.
 2. Torpid, Ragh. 19, 21.
 3. Large.
 4. Crooked.
 5. Stupid.
 6. Low.
 II. m.
 1. A treasure.
 2. Fruit.
 3. An obstacle.
 4. A churning-stick.
 5. A proper name, Hit. 58, 7, M.M.
 III. n. Safflower.
मन्थरु मन्थ् + अरु, m. The wind from a whisk.

मन्थिन् मन्थ् + इन्,
 I. adj.
 1. Churning.
 2. Afflicting.
 II. f. नी, A churn.
 --Comp.

मन्द् मन्द् (from मद्), i. 1, Ātm.
 1. † To get drunk.
 2. To rejoice.
 3. To praise.
 4. To sleep.
 5. † To languish.
 6. † To move slowly.
 7. † To shine.
 --Cf. probably Lat. mundus; O.H.G. mandjan, to rejoice.

मन्द मन्द,
 I. adj.
 1. Slow, Śṛṅgārat. 7.
 2. Stupid, Chr. 8, 31.
 3. Unlucky.
 4. Little, Hit. 58, 13.
 5. Low (as a tone), Rām. 3, 55, 36 (adv.); Pañc. 173, 1.
 6. Doubled, मन्दंमन्दम्, adv. Very slowly, Pañc. 90, 21.
 II. m.
 1. A name of Saturn.
 2. A name of Yama.
 --Comp.
मन्दगतित्व मन्द-गति + त्व, n. Property of moving slowly, Pañc. 142, 11.
मन्दत्व मन्द + त्व, n. Foolishness, Pañc. ii. d. 179.
मन्दन मन्द् + अन, n. Praise.
मन्दभाग्यता मन्द-भाग्य + ता, f. Misfortune, Pañc. 227, 20.

मन्दर मन्दर (cf. मन्थर, and vb. मन्द्),
 I. adj.
 1. Slow.
 2. Large
 II. m.
 1. The name of a fabulous mountain with which the ocean was churned, MBh. 1, 1112; Kir. 5, 30.
 2. The mandara tree, one of the trees of paradise.
 3. The paradise.
 4. A mirror.

मन्दार मन्दार (vb. मन्द्), m.
 1. One of the five trees in Indra's paradise, Vikr. d. 6, 127; Megh. 73.
 2. The coral tree, Erythrina fulgens, Megh. 68.
 3. Swallow-wort, Asclepias gigantea.
 --Comp.

मन्दसान मन्दसान (vb. मन्द्), m.
 1. A name of Agni.
 2. Life.
 3. Sleep.
मन्दाक मन्दाक, n. A current, a stream.
मन्दाकिनी मन्दाकिनी, i. e. मन्दाक + इन्, f. The Ganges of heaven, Utt. Rāmac. 158, 3.
मन्दाय मन्दाय, a denomin. derived from मन्द with य, Ātm. To go tardily, to delay, Vikr. d. 56; Megh. 39.
मन्दारवती मन्दारवती, i. e. मन्दार + वन्त् + ई, f. A proper name, Lass. 16, 6.
मन्दारु मन्दारु, m. The coral tree, Erythrina fulgens (see मन्दार).

मन्दिर मन्दिर,
 I. m.
 1. The sea.
 2. The back of the knee.
 II. f. रा, A stable.
 III. f. रा, and n. A house, Hit. ii. d. 126 (n.); a palace, Vikr. 35, 2; Kathās. 26, 283 (f.).
 IV. n.
 1. A town.
 2. A temple.
 --Comp.
मन्दुरा मन्दुरा, f. A stable for horses, Weber, Ind. St. iii. 370, 14.

मन्द्र मन्द्र, m.
 1. A deep, hollow, or low tone, or sound, Megh. 97 (read मन्द्र-); Vikr. 65, 11 (adj.?).
 2. A sort of drum.
 --Comp.
मन्धातृ मन्धातृ, m. A proper name, Chr. 297, 13 = Rigv. i. 112, 13.
मान्धातृ मान्धातृ, m. A proper name, Pañc. iii. d. 270.

मन्मथ मन्मथ (frequent. of मन्थ् + अ), m.
 1. A name of the god of love, Pañc. 216, 17.
 2. Love, Ṛt. 1, 27.
 3. The elephant or wood-apple.
मान्मथ मान्मथ. i. e. मन्मथ + अ, adj. Caused by love, Prab. 41, 4.
मन्मय मन्मय, i. e. 2. मद् + मय, adj. Full of me, attached to me, Bhag. 4, 10.
ऽमन्य -मन् + य, latter part of comp. adj. Thinking one's self; e. g. ज्ञ + म्-मन्य, adj. Thinking one's self a wise man, Rājat. 3, 491.
मन्या मन्या, f. The tendon forming the nape of the neck.

मन्यु मन् + यु, m.
 1. Anger, Utt. Rāmac. 83, 11; fury, Pañc. 59, 16.
 2. Sorrow, grief, Chr. 7, 21; Utt. Rāmac. 94, 14.
 3. Distress.
 4. A sacrifice.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. μῆνις.

मन्युमन्त् मन्यु + मन्त्, adj., f. मती,
 1. Angry.
 2. Sorrowful.

मन्वन्तर मन्वन्तर, i. e. मनु-अन्तर,
 1. The period of a Manu, equal [] to seventy-one ages of the gods, Man. 1, 79; Utt. Rāmac. 19, 7; fourteen मन्वन्तरस् constitute a कल्प.

मांस मांस, the base of many cases is optionally मांस् मांस्, n. Flesh, Pañc. iii. d. 139; meat.
 --Comp.
मांसज मांस-ज, n. Marrow, or serum of the flesh.
मांसत्व मांस + त्व, n. The true etymology of मांस, Man. 5, 55.
मांसमय मांस + मय, adj., f. यी, Of flesh, MBh. 1, 4495.
मांसल मांस + ल, adj. Strong, Utt. Rāmac. 154, 9.
मांसाद मांसाद, i. e. माम्स-अद् + अ, and मांसाशिन् मांसाशिन्, i. e. मांस- 2. अश् + इन्, adj. Feeding on flesh, Pañc. 59, 10; 60, 7.
मांसिक मांसिक, i. e. माम्स + इक, 1. A vendor of flesh or meat.

मान मान,
 I. m., i. e. मान् + अ.
 1. Self-confidence, Pañc. v. d. 3.
 2. Pride, Pañc. iii. d. 13.
 3. Arrogance, Pañc. iii. d. 108; female caprice, indignation, anger, Vikr. 37, 8.
 4. Honour, Pañc. 16, 4; i. d. 251.
 5. Taking.
 6. An agent.
 7. A blockhead.
 8. A barbarian.
 II. i. e. मा + अन, n.
 1. Measuring, Bhāṣāp. 108.
 2. Measure in general, Pañc. 7, 16 (कूट-तुला-, With a wrong balance).
 3. A particular measure, the fourth part [] of a खारी.
 4. The computation of the duration of a year.
 --Comp.

मानद मान-द (vb. दा), adj.
 1. Inspiring pride; a respectful address, used only in the voc. sing. m., Chr. 38, 15; Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 830.
मानधानिका मानधानिका, f. A cucumber.
मानयितृ मानयितृ, i. e. मन्, Caus., + तृ, m. One who honours, Indr. 4, 9.

मानव मानव, i. e. मनु + अ,
 I. adj.
 1. Human, Utt. Rāmac. 53, 1.
 2. Declared by Manu, Chr. 135, 1. 2.
 II. m.
 1. A man, Pañc. iii. d. 61; mankind, Chr. 8, 33.
 2. A boy.
 III. f. वी.
 1. A woman.
 2. A daughter of the first Manu.
 --Comp.

मानवन्त् मान + वन्त्, adj., f. वती.
 1. Proud.
 2. Angry, Śiś. 9, 84.
मानव्य मानव्य, i. e. मानव + य, n. A multitude of boys (and of men).
ऽमानिक -मानिक, i. e. मानिन् + क, in पन्डित-, adj. Fancying one's self a learned man, MBh. 12, 6738.

मानिन् मानिन्, i. e. मान + इन्, and मन् + इन्,
 I. adj., f. नी.
 1. Proud, Ragh. 13, 38.
 2. When latter part of a comp., Who thinks or fancies (cf. comp.).
 II. f. नी.
 1. A woman, especially one indignant towards her lover, Vikr. d. 118.
 2. A plant, commonly प्रियङ्गु.
 --Comp.

मानुष मानुष, i. e. मनुस् (q. cf.), + अ,
 I. adj., f. षी.
 1. Human, Rām. 3, 53, 3; 54, 17.
 2. Relating to mankind, Man. 4, 124.
 II. m. A man, Pañc. 61, 10.
 III. f. षी, A woman, Nal. 13, 55.
 IV. n. Human effort, Chr. 56, 16 (दैवं मानुषोपेतम्, Fate combined with human effort).
 --Comp.
मानुष्यक मानुष्य + क, n. A multitude of men.

मान्द्य मान्द्य, i. e. मन्द + य, n.
 1. Indisposition, sickness.
 2. Stupidity, torpor, Vedāntas. in Chr. 218, 17.
 3. Slowness, languishing (and stupidity), Pañc. i. d. 205.
 --Comp.
मनोरथ मनोरथ, i. e. मनस्-, m. wish, desire, Vikr. 13, 20.
मानुष- + राक्षस मानुष- + राक्षस, m. a Rākṣasa-like man, a Rākṣasa in the shape of man, Bhartṛ. 2, 66.
मांस- + रुचि मांस- + रुचि, adj. liking flesh, Hit. 42, 7, M.M.
मनस्- + लौल्य मनस्- + लौल्य, n. covetousness of mind, Hit. 87, 1.
मांस-पिण्ड-गृहीत- + वदन मांस-पिण्ड-गृहीत- + वदन, adj., f. ना, carrying [] in the mouth a piece of flesh, Pañc. 226, 20.
मन्त्र-ओषधि- + वश मन्त्र-ओषधि- + वश, adj. to be overcome by charms and herbs, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 3197.
मन्त्र- + वादिन् मन्त्र- + वादिन्, adj. sbst. one who is conversant with charms, Pañc. 210, 17; 43, 10; Lass. 16, 12.
मांस- + विक्रयिन् मांस- + विक्रयिन्, m. a vendor of flesh, a term of reproach.
मन्द- + विसर्पिन् मन्द- + विसर्पिन्, adj. moving slowly, Pañc. i. d. 282 (a louse).
मन्त्र- + वीज मन्त्र- + वीज, n. seed-like deliberation, Hit. ii. d. 138.
मानोत्सेकपराक्रम- + व्यसनिन् मानोत्सेकपराक्रम- + व्यसनिन्, i. e. मान-उत्सेक-पराक्रम-व्यसन + इन्, adj. endowed with pride, loftiness, prowess, and intent application, Pañc. iii. d. 264.
मनःशिल मनःशिल, i. e. मनस्-, m., and f. ला, red arsenic.
मांस- + शील मांस- + शील, adj. fleshy.
मन्थ- + शैल मन्थ- + शैल, m. the mount Mandara.
मन्त्रिश्रोत्रिय मन्त्रिश्रोत्रिय, i. e. मन्त्रिन्-, m. a श्रोत्रिय- like minister, Pañc. 25, 13.
मानुष- + संभव मानुष- + संभव, adj. coming from a man, Pañc. 141, 3.
मन्त्र- + साधन मन्त्र- + साधन, n. a magical performance, Lass. 3, 16 (घोर-, dele' before घोर).
मान- + सूत्र मान- + सूत्र, n. 1. a chain of gold or silver worn round the loins. 2. a thread for measuring, Daśak. in Chr. 186, 11.
मनोहत मनोहत, i. e. मनस्-, adj. disappointed.
मांस- + हासा मंस- + हास, f. सा, skin.
